judge.rationale: The candidate implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is unfinished and was left mid-flight, including committing the internal `.lore/dod.md` scratchpad. In `registry.ts`, `import Ajv from 'ajv'` under NodeNext ESM module resolution will fail `npm run typecheck` (the reference uses named `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`), and validation happens *after* `log.info('tool', 'executing', ...)` without emitting the required warning log naming failing paths on rejection. Most of the acceptance criteria are missing: `registry.test.ts` only has 1 of the required unit tests (missing extra properties, wrong-typed field, dynamic schema switching, static caching, unknown tool, and log redaction tests in `registry.test.ts`, plus the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`), though a few were put in a non-standard `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were performed, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete and placed under a new `[Unreleased]` heading instead of `[0.3.0]`.
